facts.label: Instruções e quantidades
facts.sub: Use o verbo base para dar instruções: Take some bread. Use how many com coisas contáveis e how much com bread: How many ducks are there? How much bread do I need?

facts.label: Imperativo
facts.sub: Para dar uma instrução, use o verbo base, sem sujeito: Take some bread. Throw it slowly. Break it into small pieces. Para pedir com gentileza, junte please: Please wait here.

facts.label: How many
facts.sub: Para perguntar o número de coisas que dá para contar, use how many + plural: How many ducks are there? A resposta usa there are: There are twelve. Pergunte com atenção ao plural.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The imperative has no subject: “Take some bread.”
We use how many with things we can count.
We say “How many bread do I need?”

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The imperative has no subject: “Take some bread.” → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We use how many with things we can count. → Verdadeiro (Yes: ducks, swans.)
We say “How many bread do I need?” → Falso (We say How much bread.)

pages.title: A cool lake · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cool Sunday morning at a lake in Dublin. Gray clouds move over the water. Liam stands near the shore with a bag. Many ducks swim near his feet. His friend Leo walks along the path. Liam waves and calls him.
“Hi, Leo! Come and feed the ducks with me.” says Liam. “Great idea! How many ducks are there?” says Leo. “There are about twelve. Look at the ducklings!” says Liam.
